Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Rishabh - 10 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Ananya - 9 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
3. Sunita - 40 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
4. Savitri - 64 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Rishabh stands in the park. Sunita and Ananya stand near him.]

Sunita: "Rishabh, what's the plan today?"

[Rishabh plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Rishabh (happily): "One more time!"

[Rishabh feeds the birds.]

Rishabh (happily): "How beautiful!"

[Rishabh does push-ups.]

Sunita: "And then?"

Scene 2: The road - Day

[Rishabh stands by the road. Sunita and Ananya stand near him.]

Ananya: "Let's begin."

[Rishabh rides his bicycle down the road.]

Rishabh: "This is amazing!"

[Rishabh gets into the car.]

Ananya (excited): "What next?"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Ananya and Sunita stand near him.]

Sunita: "So, here we are!"

[Rishabh folds his hands and prays.]

Sunita: "How beautiful!"

[Ananya draws a rangoli at the door.]

Ananya: "Mom, listen!"

[Rishabh paints a picture.]

Rishabh: "What happened?"

[Rishabh draws a picture of the house.]

Rishabh: "I really enjoyed today."
